name: Cell-Definition-Shape Geometry Model
definition: A Cell is a lightweight value type containing a Definition by value and an orientation. It shares immutable data via std::shared_ptr<const Data> within the Definition, allowing multiple cells to share the same geometry and material bindings without a global registry.
summary: The Cell-Definition-Shape model is an immutable data structure for non-regular volumes that decouples geometry from placement via shared pointers, enabling efficient storage without global registries.
